description: Deterministic direct check of CLM-DURABLE-BAL: with a Durable replica and a fixed instance (bal=7, vbal=2, Status=ACCEPTED, Seq=5, Deps=[-1,-1,-1]), call the real recordInstanceMetadata with an os.Pipe StableStore and observe whether the record's first four bytes carry bal. The discriminator is the bal slot of the emitted record; the prefix is a legal local construction (no network, no protocol-run) permitted because the obligation is about the bytes this function produces.

harness.description: Internal package-epaxos Go test that emits a durable_meta_case prerequisite event and a durable_meta_record result event carrying the case identity, the raw first four bytes and the bal_persisted boolean.
semantic_changes: Test-only harness file added under epaxos/assurance_generated_test.go; no target source or protocol logic is modified.
StableStore is provided as an os.Pipe so the record bytes can be read without touching the filesystem.
The harness calls recordInstanceMetadata directly rather than driving a full replica, because the obligation constrains the bytes this function writes.

legality.derivation: recordInstanceMetadata is unexported and reachable from an internal package-epaxos test; it reads only r.Durable, r.N, the instance fields and r.StableStore, so a minimal replica plus an os.Pipe is a complete and legal construction for observing the bytes it writes. Callers pass every instance state change through it when Durable, so the observed call shape matches production use.
legality.applicability: Applies when Durable is true; the fixed case uses bal=7 and vbal=2, which differ, as the obligation requires.
unresolved: No in-repository reader of the record was found, so the consequence of the lost bal for recovery is not part of this observation.
alternatives: A full-replica run with Durable=true would exercise the same function through startPhase1, but it adds peers, RPC registration and timing without changing which bytes are written.

grounding.derivation: The record's first four bytes are the slot the function reserves for bal before the second PutUint32 overwrites it, so bal_persisted records exactly the field the obligation covers.

observable_properties.description: For an instance whose bal and vbal differ, the durable metadata record produced by recordInstanceMetadata must carry bal in its own field, so bal_persisted must be true on the result event of the same case as the admitted setup event.

uncertainties: The check observes only the bytes the function writes; it does not observe any restart that would consume the record, because no such reader exists in the captured files.
